Honor when consistent with rules_digest. distances_to_visible_enemies on each legal option: engine-computed hex distances — do not recompute. distances_to_last_known_enemies on each legal option (when present): hex distances to enemies not currently visible. Use to CLOSE distance when advancing. last_known_enemy_positions (top-level, when present): list of out-of-sight enemies with cell, turn_last_seen, health. DISTANCE RULE: When advancing safely, prefer the legal option with lowest hex_dist to the priority enemy. Min-range gap: actions with min_range > 0 cannot hit closer targets. Close to melee against ranged-only enemies. Stacking: a targeted attack on a tile with multiple enemies damages all. Focus fire kills faster than spreading damage.
